title: NetworkPolicy
description: Network policy configuration (bucket B) — runtime-dynamic, persisted in Neo4j.

publicRegistration.description: Whether new users can register without an invite code.

inviteRegistration.description: Whether registration via invite code is enabled.

askForRealName.description: Whether registration asks for the user's real (given / family) name. Read during anonymous registration, so visible to 'public'.

requireLocation.description: Whether a location is mandatory on registration and in profile settings. Read during anonymous registration, so visible to 'public'.

inviteLinkLimit.description: Maximum number of personal invite links a user may have. Only relevant to logged-in users (invitations UI), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

inviteCodesPersonalPerUser.description: Maximum number of personal invite codes a single user may generate. Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

inviteCodesGroupPerUser.description: Maximum number of group invite codes a single user may generate per group. Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

categoriesActive.description: Whether the categories feature for posts and groups is active.

badgesEnabled.description: Whether the badges feature is enabled (badges shown on profiles / teasers and managed in admin). Shown on publicly visible profiles, so visible to 'public'.

apiKeysEnabled.description: Whether API keys functionality (personal keys for backend access) is enabled. Only relevant to logged-in users (Settings / Admin), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

apiKeysMaxPerUser.description: Maximum number of active API keys a single user may hold. Only relevant to logged-in users (Settings), so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

maxPinnedPosts.description: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned network-wide (0 disables pinning). Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).

maxGroupPinnedPosts.description: Maximum number of posts that can be pinned within a group (0 disables pinning). Only relevant to logged-in users, so visible to 'authenticated' (and admin).
